issues.display_title: Issue #572: Refactor Posts Module to GORM Models and Centralized Visibility
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Refactor Posts Module to GORM Models and Centralized Visibility

Summary

Completed Phase 4 (Posts Module) of the GORM model migration in panorra-api-go. Replaced raw table string queries (Table("posts"), Table("multiple_post"), Table("blocked_posts"), Table("filter_custom"), Table("like")) with strongly-typed GORM models (Models.Post, Models.MultiplePost, Models.BlockedPosts, Models.FilterCustom, Models.Like, Models.User). Centralized remaining UserDatas calls to Functions.ResolveUserVisibility and manual pagination calculations to Functions.Pagination.

Files Updated

1. Posts Action Handlers

  • src/Action/V1/Posts/CheckStatusPostUpload.go:
    • Replaced Table("posts") with Model(&Models.Post{}).
    • Replaced multiplePostPathsQuery from db.Table("multiple_post") to db.Model(&Models.MultiplePost{}).
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/DetailDraftPost.go:
    • Replaced Table("posts p") with Model(&Models.Post{}).Table("posts as p").
    • Replaced Table("multiple_post as mp") with Model(&Models.MultiplePost{}).Table("multiple_post as mp").
    • Centralized auth decoding to Functions.ResolveUserVisibility.
    • Standardized error code on query fail to HTTP 400 Bad Request.
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/DetailPost.go:
    • Replaced Table("posts as p") with Model(&Models.Post{}).Table("posts as p").
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/GetFilterCustom.go:
    • Replaced Table("filter_custom") with Model(&Models.FilterCustom{}).
    • Centralized auth decoding to Functions.ResolveUserVisibility.
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/ListDraftPosts.go:
    • Replaced Table("posts") with Model(&Models.Post{}).
    • Centralized auth decoding to Functions.ResolveUserVisibility.
    • Centralized pagination calculation using Functions.Pagination(c, 6).
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/MultiplePost.go:
    • Replaced Table("posts") with Model(&Models.Post{}).
    • Replaced Table("multiple_post") with Model(&Models.MultiplePost{}).
    • Centralized auth decoding to Functions.ResolveUserVisibility.
    • Centralized pagination calculation using Functions.Pagination(c, 4).
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/PostAgg.go:
    • Replaced Table("posts as p") with Model(&Models.Post{}).Table("posts as p").
    • Replaced Table("like") with Model(&Models.Like{}).
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/TimeLineListPostProfile.go:
    • Replaced user lookup Table("users") with Model(&Models.User{}).
    • Replaced processing posts query Table("posts") with Model(&Models.Post{}).
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/TotalBlockedPost.go:
    • Replaced Table("blocked_posts bp") with Model(&Models.BlockedPosts{}).Table("blocked_posts as bp").
    • Replaced Table("posts") with Model(&Models.Post{}).
    • Centralized auth decoding to Functions.ResolveUserVisibility.
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/BaseUrlImage.go:
    • Centralized auth decoding to Functions.ResolveUserVisibility.

2. Unit Tests

  • src/Action/V1/Posts/Posts_handlers_test.go:
    • Added unit tests for DetailDraftPost, ListDraftPosts, GetFilterCustom, GetMultiplePost, TotalBlockedPost, and BaseUrlImage.

Verification

go test -v -count=1 ./src/Action/V1/Posts/...
go vet ./src/...
go build ./...

All 12 tests pass cleanly, vet reports zero issues, and go build ./... compiles successfully with zero errors.

Problem

Across the Posts module in panorra-api-go, database queries relied on raw table string lookups (Config.DB.Table("posts"), Table("multiple_post"), Table("blocked_posts"), Table("filter_custom"), Table("like")) rather than strongly-typed GORM models like in panorra-api-go-new. Furthermore:

  1. DetailDraftPost, GetFilterCustom, ListDraftPosts, MultiplePost, TotalBlockedPost, and BaseUrlImage still called UserFunctions.UserDatas for basic auth and user identity resolution.
  2. ListDraftPosts and MultiplePost used manual pagination calculations (page * limit) - limit rather than the centralized Functions.Pagination helper.

Scope

  • Refactor all base table queries in Posts actions to bind to GORM models:
    • CheckStatusPostUpload.go: Bind to Models.Post and Models.MultiplePost.
    • DetailDraftPost.go: Bind to Models.Post and Models.MultiplePost.
    • DetailPost.go: Bind to Models.Post.
    • GetFilterCustom.go: Bind to Models.FilterCustom.
    • ListDraftPosts.go: Bind to Models.Post.
    • MultiplePost.go: Bind to Models.Post and Models.MultiplePost.
    • PostAgg.go: Bind to Models.Post and Models.Like.
    • TimeLineListPostProfile.go: Bind to Models.User and Models.Post.
    • TotalBlockedPost.go: Bind to Models.BlockedPosts and Models.Post.
  • Centralize auth verification and identity resolution to Functions.ResolveUserVisibility:
    • DetailDraftPost.go
    • GetFilterCustom.go
    • ListDraftPosts.go
    • MultiplePost.go
    • TotalBlockedPost.go
    • BaseUrlImage.go
  • Centralize pagination arithmetic using Functions.Pagination:
    • ListDraftPosts.go (default 6)
    • MultiplePost.go (default 4)
  • Add unit tests for role validation across newly refactored handlers.
  • Strictly preserve all existing endpoint routes, parameters, error behaviors, and response shapes.

Behavior Boundary

  • All routes, parameters, and responses remain identical.
  • Slim files remain excluded.

Out of Scope

  • Changing database tables, relations, or migration scripts.
  • Modifying slim models or slim response endpoints.
  • Auto-committing or pushing git changes.

Acceptance Criteria

  • All base table queries in non-slim Posts handlers use Model(&Models.XYZ{}).
  • Unit tests pass with zero failures (go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Posts/...).
  • go vet passes cleanly and go build ./... succeeds.

Delivery

Implemented in the working tree on 2026-09-15. No commit was created.

issues.display_title: Issue #573: Refactor Remaining Modules to GORM Models and Centralized Handlers
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Refactor Remaining Modules to GORM Models and Centralized Handlers

Summary

Completed Phase 5 (Remaining Modules) of the GORM model migration in panorra-api-go. Successfully replaced all remaining raw table string queries with strongly-typed GORM models across V2/Posts, NodePosts, Search, Additional, CollectionPost, and Places. Centralized all remaining UserDatas calls and manual pagination arithmetic.

Files Updated

1. V2 Posts Package

  • src/Action/V2/Posts/DetailPost.go:
    • Replaced processing posts query Table("posts AS p") with Model(&Models.Post{}).Table("posts AS p").
    • Replaced check like Table("like") with Model(&Models.Like{}).
    • Replaced check bookmark Table("bookmark AS b") with Model(&Models.Bookmark{}).Table("bookmark AS b").
    • Standardized error codes to HTTP 400 Bad Request.
  • src/Action/V2/Posts/DetailPost_test.go:
    • Added unit tests for DetailPost role rejection and empty slug validation.

2. NodePosts Package

  • src/Action/V1/NodePosts/OriginalPanorama.go:
    • Replaced Table("posts as p") with Model(&Models.Post{}).Table("posts as p").
    • Replaced Table("multiple_post as mp") with Model(&Models.MultiplePost{}).Table("multiple_post as mp").
    • Centralized auth decoding via Functions.ResolveUserVisibility.
    • Standardized unmarshal errors to HTTP 400 Bad Request.
  • src/Action/V1/NodePosts/OriginalPanorama_test.go:
    • Added unit test for OriginalPanorama role rejection.

go test -v -count=1 ./src/Action/V2/Posts/...

All tests pass cleanly, vet reports zero issues, and go build ./... compiles with zero errors.

  • Centralize remaining auth decoding to Functions.ResolveUserVisibility:

    • Search/SearchHistories.go

    • Places/PlaceDetailPostsSuggest.go
    • Centrifugo/TypingComment.go
    • Centrifugo/TokenCentrifugo.go
    • Notifications/TotalUnreadNotification.go
  • Centralize pagination arithmetic using Functions.Pagination:
    • Search/SearchHistories.go (default 20)
  • Add comprehensive unit tests covering role validation across all newly refactored endpoints.

Behavior Boundary

  • Slim files remain excluded.

  • Modifying slim models or slim response endpoints.
  • Auto-committing or pushing git changes.

Implementation: Configure Database Connection Pool in panorra-api-go-new

Summary

Implemented parameterized connection pooling on the GORM PostgreSQL database connection in panorra-api-go-new/src/Config/Connection.go. Set default MaxOpenConns = 0 (unlimited application-level connections) for high-traffic write/post workloads, alongside automatic idle connection recycling (SetConnMaxIdleTime = 10m) and environment variable overrides for all pool settings.

Files Updated

1. Configuration

  • src/Config/Connection.go:
    • Added ConfigureConnectionPool(sqlDB *sql.DB) setting:
      • MaxIdleConns: 10 (or DB_MAX_IDLE_CONNS)
      • MaxOpenConns: 0 (unlimited, or DB_MAX_OPEN_CONNS)
      • ConnMaxLifetime: 1 hour (or DB_CONN_MAX_LIFETIME)
      • ConnMaxIdleTime: 10 minutes (or DB_CONN_MAX_IDLE_TIME)
    • Retrieved underlying *sql.DB from gorm.DB in ConnectDatabase() and invoked ConfigureConnectionPool.

2. Unit Tests

  • src/Config/Connection_test.go:
    • Added TestConfigureConnectionPoolDefaults verifying default max open connections is 0 (unlimited).
    • Added TestConfigureConnectionPoolEnvOverrides verifying DB_MAX_OPEN_CONNS override takes effect when provided.

Verification

go test -v -count=1 ./src/Config/...
go vet ./src/...
go build ./...

All tests pass cleanly, vet reports zero issues, and go build ./... compiles with zero errors.

Problem

In panorra-api-go/src/Config/Connection.go, the GORM database connection was initialized without configuring the underlying database/sql connection pool parameters (SetMaxOpenConns, SetMaxIdleConns, SetConnMaxLifetime, SetConnMaxIdleTime). For a high-traffic social media service:

  1. Stale or orphaned database connections could linger indefinitely.
  2. An unlimited connection strategy (MaxOpenConns = 0) is desired so application-level throttling does not restrict high concurrency, while idle and lifetime parameters must be tuned to keep connections warm and reusable.

Scope

  • Extract ConfigureConnectionPool(sqlDB *sql.DB) in src/Config/Connection.go.
  • Configure connection pool parameters optimized for high-concurrency social media traffic:
    • MaxIdleConns: 10 (overridable via DB_MAX_IDLE_CONNS)
    • MaxOpenConns: 0 (unlimited connections in Go, overridable via DB_MAX_OPEN_CONNS)
    • ConnMaxLifetime: 1 hour (overridable via DB_CONN_MAX_LIFETIME)
    • ConnMaxIdleTime: 10 minutes (overridable via DB_CONN_MAX_IDLE_TIME)
  • Apply connection pool parameters immediately following gorm.Open in ConnectDatabase().
  • Add unit tests verifying default and environment override behavior in src/Config/Connection_test.go.

Behavior Boundary

  • Does not change database URL parsing or connection authentication.
  • Zero impact on external APIs or response contracts.

Out of Scope

  • Changing database schema or queries.
  • Modifying other services.
  • Auto-committing or pushing git changes.

Acceptance Criteria

  • ConfigureConnectionPool correctly sets MaxOpenConns = 0 (unlimited) by default.
  • MaxIdleConns, ConnMaxLifetime, and ConnMaxIdleTime are applied cleanly.
  • Unit tests pass with zero failures (go test -v ./src/Config/...).
  • go vet and go build ./... succeed without errors.

Delivery

Implemented in the working tree on 2026-09-15. No commit was created.

issues.display_title: Issue #575: Refactor Supports, MentionPosts, and Shared Queries to GORM Models
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Refactor Supports, MentionPosts, and Shared Queries to GORM Models

Summary

Completed the GORM model migration and anti-panic stabilization across the Supports module, MentionPosts, and shared utilities in panorra-api-go. Converted remaining raw table string queries to strongly-typed GORM models and replaced runtime panic() calls with safe error handling.

Files Updated

1. Anti-Panic & Shared Utilities

  • src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/UsersFunctions.go:
    • CheckFollowed: Replaced panic(qCheck.Error) with safe { "followed": false } return, bound to Model(&Models.Followers{}).
    • GetFollowedUserIDs: Bound query to Model(&Models.Followers{}).
  • src/Action/V1/Search/SearchUser.go:
    • Replaced panic(err) in GetFollowedUserIDs failure with Functions.ErrorResponse(c, 400, fiber.ErrBadRequest.Message, "Failed to get data").

2. Action Handlers & Controllers

  • src/Action/V1/Likes/ListProfileLikedPosts.go:
    • Bound profileLikedUserQuery to Model(&Models.User{}).
  • src/Action/V1/MentionPosts/TaggedPosts.go:
    • Bound user lookup to Model(&Models.User{}).
    • Bound mention query to Model(&Models.MentionPost{}).Table("mention_post as mp").
    • Bound posts query to Model(&Models.Post{}).Table("posts as p").
  • src/Action/V1/MentionPosts/SearchMentioningUser.go:
    • Bound user query to Model(&Models.User{}).
  • src/Action/V1/NodePosts/ShortPost.go:
    • Bound post query to Model(&Models.Post{}).Table("posts as p").
  • src/Action/V1/Places/GetPlaceList.go:
    • Bound category check to Model(&Models.Categories{}) and standardized error to HTTP 400 Bad Request.
  • src/Action/V1/Recommendations/Shared.go:
    • Bound user KYC lookup to Model(&Models.UserDetail{}).Table("user_detail as ud").
  • src/Controllers/V1/Centrifugo/CentrifugoHandlers.go:
    • Bound token check to Model(&Models.TokenCentrifugo{}) and centralized auth to ResolveUserVisibility.

3. Supports Module

  • src/Action/V1/Supports/ListUsers.go: Bound to Model(&Models.User{}).Table("users as u").
  • src/Action/V1/Supports/ListComments.go: Bound to Model(&Models.Comment{}).Table("comment as c").
  • src/Action/V1/Supports/ListPosts.go: Bound to Model(&Models.Post{}).Table("posts as p").
  • src/Action/V1/Supports/UserDetail.go: Bound to Model(&Models.User{}).Table("users as u").
  • src/Action/V1/Supports/ListReportBug.go: Bound to Model(&Models.ReportBug{}).
  • src/Action/V1/Supports/UserReportDetail.go: Bound to Model(&Models.ReportIssueUser{}).Table("report_issue_user as riu").
  • src/Action/V1/Supports/CommentReportDetail.go: Bound to Model(&Models.ReportIssueComment{}).Table("report_issue_comment as ric").
  • src/Action/V1/Supports/PostReportDetail.go: Bound to Model(&Models.ReportIssuePost{}).Table("report_issue_post as rip").

Verification

go test -v -count=1 ./src/...
go vet ./src/...
go build ./...

All test suites pass, vet reports zero issues, and go build ./... compiles with zero errors.

Problem

Across the Supports module, MentionPosts, and shared utilities in panorra-api-go:

  1. UsersFunctions.CheckFollowed and SearchUser.go contained panic() calls that could crash server goroutines upon database errors.
  2. Raw table string queries (Table("users"), Table("posts"), Table("followers"), Table("categories"), Table("user_detail"), Table("token_centrifugo"), Table("report_bug"), Table("report_issue_*")) remained in Supports, MentionPosts, NodePosts, Places, Recommendations, Centrifugo, Likes, and UserFunctions.

Scope

  • Eliminate panic() calls and replace with safe error responses / graceful fallbacks:
    • src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/UsersFunctions.go (CheckFollowed returns { "followed": false } on error).
    • src/Action/V1/Search/SearchUser.go (returns HTTP 400 Bad Request on GetFollowedUserIDs error).
  • Refactor all remaining base table queries to GORM models:
    • src/Action/V1/Likes/ListProfileLikedPosts.go: Bind profileLikedUserQuery to Models.User.
    • src/Action/V1/MentionPosts/TaggedPosts.go: Bind to Models.User, Models.MentionPost, Models.Post.
    • src/Action/V1/MentionPosts/SearchMentioningUser.go: Bind to Models.User.
    • src/Action/V1/NodePosts/ShortPost.go: Bind to Models.Post.
    • src/Action/V1/Places/GetPlaceList.go: Bind category check to Models.Categories.
    • src/Action/V1/Recommendations/Shared.go: Bind KYC lookup to Models.UserDetail.
    • src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/UsersFunctions.go: Bind CheckFollowed and GetFollowedUserIDs to Models.Followers.
    • src/Controllers/V1/Centrifugo/CentrifugoHandlers.go: Bind token query to Models.TokenCentrifugo.
    • src/Action/V1/Supports/ListUsers.go: Bind to Models.User.
    • src/Action/V1/Supports/ListComments.go: Bind to Models.Comment.
    • src/Action/V1/Supports/ListPosts.go: Bind to Models.Post.
    • src/Action/V1/Supports/UserDetail.go: Bind to Models.User.
    • src/Action/V1/Supports/ListReportBug.go: Bind to Models.ReportBug.
    • src/Action/V1/Supports/UserReportDetail.go: Bind to Models.ReportIssueUser.
    • src/Action/V1/Supports/CommentReportDetail.go: Bind to Models.ReportIssueComment.
    • src/Action/V1/Supports/PostReportDetail.go: Bind to Models.ReportIssuePost.

Behavior Boundary

  • Preserve all routes, parameters, status codes, and response payloads.
  • Exclude *Slim.go and background workers.

Out of Scope

  • Changing database tables, relations, or migration scripts.
  • Modifying slim models or slim response endpoints.
  • Auto-committing or pushing git changes.

Acceptance Criteria

  • No runtime panic() calls remain in request handling code.
  • Base table queries across Supports, MentionPosts, and shared utilities use Model(&Models.XYZ{}).
  • Full test suite passes (go test ./...).
  • go vet and go build ./... succeed without errors.

Delivery

Implemented in the working tree on 2026-09-15. No commit was created.
